name: syncope
concept: An autonomous end-to-end request-smuggling attacker for the docker-compose nginx/gunicorn lab: multi-repetition CL.TE/TE.CL/TE.TE differential probe batteries with latency-orthogonality + teardown significance scoring, every finding gated on the patched-control proxy staying clean across the same probes, then auto-selects the highest-confidence variant to mount FE-auth-bypass / cache-poisoning / stored-XSS weaponization to an admin RCE sink. Post-RCE it fires a loud marker-tagged persistence + mini-C2 beacon + self-inventorying recovery tail whose SHA-256-verified zero-survivor cleanup verdict (and defender hunt-playbook artifact) feeds the final red-team evidence report — one verifiable probe-to-wipe loop.
attack_vectors: CL.TE / TE.CL / TE.TE differential detection with latency-orthogonality + teardown-analysis significance scoring (per-technique p-value/FP-rate headline)
patched-control validation arm: same probe set replayed against patched control; findings accepted only when control stays clean (A/B FP metric gates weaponization)
cache poisoning via smuggled request reshaping origin responses
front-end auth bypass: FE logs benign request, desynced origin executes privileged one
stored-XSS / admin-session poisoning via cross-user request interleaving
RCE via desync-bypassed admin command-exec sink delivering persistence payload with execution evidence
marker-tagged loud persistence (cron/systemd or fake-scheduler stub for CI; Windows deferred)
mini-C2 check-in loop: loopback-beaconed HTTP heartbeat + dead-man kill-switch triggering wipe tail
novelty_angle: A single confidence-gated closed loop from probe to wipe: the patched-control arm measures a per-technique FP-rate that sets the significance threshold gating weaponization, and the persistence tail is deliberately loud with a marker-scoped SHA-256 artifact manifest whose verifiable zero-survivor cleanup verdict and defender hunt-playbook become the report headline — detection reliability, exploit viability, artifact inventory as one measurable chain.
dependencies: Python 3.10+ stdlib only: ipaddress, http.client, socket, ssl, hashlib, subprocess, json, time, argparse
docker-compose lab topology as first-class artifact: nginx front + gunicorn/Flask origin with admin RCE sink + patched control proxy container
Linux container with cron/systemd OR fake-scheduler stub mode for CI
optional httpx only if stdlib probing too slow
scope_gate: Per-probe ipaddress resolver gate re-validates front, origin, AND patched control against loopback/RFC1918/user lab CIDR before every request; DNS-rebinding guard re-resolves each probe; WARN banner + hard-refuse on out-of-allowlist; RCE/persistence/beacon/wipe gated additionally on per-engagement lab-UUID marker plus allowlist.
